name: [UPD Free Avatar] Mount Aosora
desc:
✨ Mount Aosora comes with stunning HD graphics 🏔️, bringing a natural atmosphere that feels lively and soothing 🍃.

Feature:
- HD graphics quality as well as flexible graphic settings options
- 17 checkpoints & Summits that will continue to be developed
- Carry feature (Touch player body) and can carry many people at once
- Aura for each title summit
- A pet that will accompany you every step of the way
- Playlist of songs (Forthcoming will be added for variations of songs)
- Variety of emotes/dances to express yourself
- Drone/Freecam to record cinematic scenes/moments
- Fireball at one of the Checkpoints to kill your opponent

With beginner-friendly trails ✨ and light obstacles full of fun 🎯, this game is perfect for new players as well as those who just want to enjoy the hiking experience while enjoying the beautiful scenery 🌌.
